subject.title: Explore Google Photos backup via Takeout or Data Portability API

question: Should gogcli own a narrow Takeout-to-Drive ingestion primitive for Photos archives, or keep complete Photos backup outside the CLI?
rationale: The broad Data Portability route is unavailable for Photos, but Drive-delivered Takeout ingestion is technically plausible and would introduce persistent state, sensitive archives, large-file transfer, and long-running backup semantics that require maintainer sponsorship.

options.title: Feasibility and narrow ingest
options.body: Document the official API limits and design a non-destructive Drive-delivered Takeout downloader before sponsoring implementation.

options.title: Keep outside gogcli
options.body: Document that complete Photos backup remains a user-managed Takeout workflow outside this CLI.

options.title: Sponsor broader backup surface
options.body: Adopt a portability or Takeout command family and accept its verification, security, and long-running workflow obligations.

recommendation.title: Feasibility and narrow ingest
recommendation.body: Document the official API limits and design a non-destructive Drive-delivered Takeout downloader before sponsoring implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Release history connects this person to both existing product surfaces whose boundary the decision would change.
